d: The Dahua DHI-IVSS7124DR is a 4U enterprise-grade intelligent video surveillance server that combines video management, recording, storage, and AI analytics in a single platform. It supports up to 256 IP cameras, advanced face recognition, video metadata, perimeter protection, and license plate comparison, making it suitable for large-scale surveillance deployments.

specs.label: Face Detection
specs.value: 1. AI by Camera: Supports 160-channel 2 MP or 80-channel 4 MP resolution with face detection IP camera; 2. Supports 6 properties: Gender, age, glasses, expression, face mask, and beard

specs.label: Face Recognition
specs.value: 1. AI by Camera: 160-channel 2 MP or 80-channel 4 MP face recognition with face recognition IPC; 2. Supports entries frequency alarm

specs.label: License Plate Database Capacity
specs.value: 1. 50 plate databases with 500,000 plate numbers in total; 2. Supports allowlist and blocklist

specs.label: Vehicle License Plate Comparison
specs.value: Supports 160-channel 2 MP or 80-channel 4 MP resolution with ITC

specs.label: Network Bandwidth
specs.value: Incoming bandwidth: 1280 Mbps; Recording bandwidth: 1280 Mbps; Outgoing bandwidth: 1280 Mbps

specs.label: Resolution
specs.value: 32 MP;24 MP;16 MP;12 MP;8 MP;6 MP;5 MP;4 MP;3 MP;1080p;720p

specs.label: Video Output
specs.value: 1-channel VGA output; 4-channel HDMI output; VGA 1/HDMI 1 outputs the same video source

specs.label: Multi-screen Display
specs.value: 1st Screen: Max. 64-channel; 2nd Screen: Max. 36-channel; 3rd Screen: Max. 1-channel; 4th Screen: Max. 1-channel
